FR-003's escape is for a class research shows to be a JUDGMENT; an attested spacing is the opposite, a rule a placer can guarantee, and sending it back through the audit (D5's path is CUT) would leave twin courses at any spacing with neither test nor review - the request's 'fix the placement algorithm and then stop checking' turned into 'stop checking'.
